description: This file defines the SlimHttpServerRequestCreator class, which implements the ServerRequestCreatorInterface to create ServerRequest objects with a decorator. It manages dependencies related to PSR-17 server request creation within the Slim Framework.

classes.name: SlimHttpServerRequestCreator
classes.description: Handles creation of server requests with optional decoration, implementing the ServerRequestCreatorInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the creator with a given ServerRequestCreatorInterface instance.

methods.name: createServerRequestFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates and decorates a server request from PHP globals, throwing exceptions if decoration class is unavailable or instantiation fails.

methods.name: isServerRequestDecoratorAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether the specified decorator class for server requests exists.
